### 📝 Changelog Reminder

Please remember to add a changelog entry for your changes by running:

```bash
changie new
```

This helps us maintain an accurate and up-to-date changelog for all releases. If you haven't installed Changie yet, you can find installation instructions at [changie.dev](https://changie.dev/).

If your change doesn't require a changelog entry (e.g., fixing typos in documentation), please explain why below.
